csv_project_name: Conslt for Murrells Inlet Business 17 Streetscape Plan
csv_scope_of_work: Georgetown County, SC is seeking a qualified firm to develop a streetscape plan for this section of Business 17 that will provide safe passage for pedestrians, bikes, boaters and vehicular traffic while maintaining environmental protections for local wildlife and the local estuary and maintaining the low country aesthetic of the fishing village. See bid document for full details and proposal submittal requirements.
